## OMOP CDM

1. John is an African American man born on August 4, 1974.  Define an entry in the `PERSON` table that encodes this information.


```{r}
library(DBI)
library(Eunomia)

cd   <- getEunomiaConnectionDetails()
conn <- DatabaseConnector::connect(cd)
# DBI::dbGetQuery(conn, "PRAGMA table_info(person)")
```

```{r}
spec <- read.csv(system.file("csv", "OMOP_CDMv5.4_Field_Level.csv",
                             package = "CommonDataModel"))

subset(spec, cdmTableName == "person",
       select = c(cdmFieldName, isRequired, cdmDatatype, userGuidance))
```
```{r}
# Proof of Concept for Identifying ConceptIDs

# Gender
DatabaseConnector::querySql(conn, "
  SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, standard_concept
  FROM main.concept
  WHERE domain_id = 'Gender' AND standard_concept = 'S'")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

person_spec <- spec |>
  filter(cdmTableName == "person") |>
  select(cdmFieldName)
```

```{r}
known_entries <- tibble::tribble(
  ~cdmFieldName,                  ~Value,                 ~Explanation,
  "person_id",                    "5",                    "A unique integer.",
  "gender_concept_id",            "8507",                 "The concept ID for male gender is 8507.",
  "year_of_birth",                "1974",                 NA,
  "month_of_birth",               "8",                    NA,
  "day_of_birth",                 "4",                    NA,
  "birth_datetime",               "1974-08-04 00:00:00",  "When the time is not known midnight is used.",
  "death_datetime",               "NULL",                 NA,
  "race_concept_id",              "8516",                 "The concept ID for black or African American is 8516.",
  "ethnicity_concept_id",         "38003564",             "38003564 refers to \"Not hispanic\".",
  "location_id",                  NA,                     "His address is not known.",
  "provider_id",                  NA,                     "His primary care Provider is not known.",
  "care_site_id",                 NA,                     "His primary Care Site is not known.",
  "person_source_value",          "NULL",                 "Not provided.",
  "gender_source_value",          "Man",                  "The text used in the description.",
  "gender_source_concept_id",     "0",                    NA,
  "race_source_value",            "African American",     "The text used in the description.",
  "race_source_concept_id",       "0",                    NA,
  "ethnicity_source_value",       "NULL",                 NA,
  "ethnicity_source_concept_id",  "0",                    NA
)
```

```{r}
person_tbl <- person_spec |>
  left_join(known_entries, by = "cdmFieldName") |>
  mutate(cdmFieldName = toupper(cdmFieldName)) |> # capitalize
  rename(`Column name` = cdmFieldName)

knitr::kable(person_tbl, caption = "The PERSON table.")
```



2. John enrolled in his current insurance on January 1st, 2015. The data from his insurance database were extracted on July 1st, 2019. Define an entry in the `OBSERVATION_PERIOD` table that encodes this information.

```{r}
spec <- read.csv(system.file("csv", "OMOP_CDMv5.4_Field_Level.csv",
                             package = "CommonDataModel"))

subset(spec, cdmTableName == "observation_period",
       select = c(cdmFieldName, isRequired, cdmDatatype, userGuidance))
```

```{r}
obs_spec <- spec |>
  filter(cdmTableName == "observation_period") |>
  select(cdmFieldName)
```

https://athena.ohdsi.org/search-terms/terms/44814724

```{r}
obs_entries <- tibble::tribble(
  ~cdmFieldName,                    ~Value,        ~Explanation,
  "observation_period_id",          "1",           "A unique integer.",
  "person_id",                      "5",           "Links to John's row in the PERSON table.",
  "observation_period_start_date",  "2015-01-01",  "Date he enrolled in his current insurance.",
  "observation_period_end_date",    "2019-07-01",  "Date the insurance data were extracted.",
  "period_type_concept_id",         "44814724",    "Concept ID for Period with Insurance"
)
```

```{r}
obs_tbl <- obs_spec |>
  left_join(obs_entries, by = "cdmFieldName") |>
  mutate(cdmFieldName = toupper(cdmFieldName)) |>
  rename(`Column name` = cdmFieldName)

knitr::kable(obs_tbl, caption = "The OBSERVATION_PERIOD table.")
```


3. John was prescribed a 30-day supply of Ibuprofen 200 MG Oral tablets (NDC code: 76168009520) on May 1st, 2019. Define an entry in the `DRUG_EXPOSURE` table that encodes this information.

https://athena.ohdsi.org/search-terms/terms/19078461

```{r}
# obtaining the column names
subset(spec, cdmTableName == "drug_exposure",
       select = c(cdmFieldName, isRequired, cdmDatatype, userGuidance))
```

```{r}
# query for ibuprofen
DatabaseConnector::querySql(conn, "
  SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id
  FROM main.concept
  WHERE LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%ibuprofen%'")

# the codes do not seem to exist in Eunomia
DatabaseConnector::querySql(conn, "
  SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, domain_id
  FROM main.concept
  WHERE domain_id = 'Route' OR vocabulary_id = 'Drug Type'")
```
- https://athena.ohdsi.org/search-terms/terms?domain=Route&page=1&pageSize=15&query=Oral
- https://athena.ohdsi.org/search-terms/terms?conceptClass=Drug+Type&page=1&pageSize=15&query=prescription+written

Many of the results show up when searching up the NDC code
- https://athena.ohdsi.org/search-terms/terms?page=1&pageSize=15&query=76168009520
- https://athena.ohdsi.org/search-terms/terms/583945

```{r}
drug_spec <- spec |>
  filter(cdmTableName == "drug_exposure") |>
  select(cdmFieldName)

drug_entries <- tibble::tribble(
  ~cdmFieldName,                  ~Value,                ~Explanation,
  "drug_exposure_id",             "1",                   "A unique integer.",
  "person_id",                    "2",                   "Links to John's row in the PERSON table.",
  "drug_concept_id",              "19078461",            "Standard RxNorm concept for Ibuprofen 200 MG Oral Tablet (via NDC 'Maps to').",
  "drug_exposure_start_date",     "2019-05-01",          "Date prescribed.",
  "drug_exposure_start_datetime", "2019-05-01 00:00:00", "Time unknown, set to midnight.",
  "drug_exposure_end_date",       "2019-05-31",          "Start date + 30-day supply.",
  "drug_exposure_end_datetime",   "2019-05-31 00:00:00", "Time unknown, set to midnight.",
  "drug_type_concept_id",         "38000177",            "Prescription written.",
  "days_supply",                  "30",                  "30-day supply.",
  "route_concept_id",             "4132161",             "Oral.",
  "drug_source_value",            "76168009520",         "The NDC code given",
  "drug_source_concept_id",       "583945",            "The concept ID of the NDC code itself (non-standard)."
)

options(knitr.kable.NA = "")

drug_tbl <- drug_spec |>
  left_join(drug_entries, by = "cdmFieldName") |>
  mutate(Value = coalesce(Value, "NULL"),   # NA -> "NULL" in Value only
         cdmFieldName = toupper(cdmFieldName)) |>
  rename(`Column name` = cdmFieldName)

knitr::kable(drug_tbl, caption = "The DRUG_EXPOSURE table.")
```

5. Using SQL and R, retrieve all records of the condition "Gastrointestinal hemorrhage" using source codes. This database uses ICD-10, and the relevant ICD-10 code is "K92.2" from the `Eunomia` dataset.

https://athena.ohdsi.org/search-terms/terms/45533625
- we can look at the results from Q4 and identify that we can  we can subset for K92.2 using the condition_source_value field in the condition_occurrence table

```{r}
sql <- "SELECT *
        FROM @cdm.condition_occurrence
        WHERE condition_source_value = 'K92.2';"

result <- renderTranslateQuerySql(conn, sql, cdm = "main")
head(result)
```

## Standardize vocabularies

7. What is the standard concept ID for "Gastrointestinal hemorrhage"?

```{r}
DatabaseConnector::querySql(conn, "
  SELECT concept_id, concept_name, concept_code
  FROM concept
  WHERE concept_name = 'Gastrointestinal hemorrhage';")
```
Relevant Athena Search: https://athena.ohdsi.org/search-terms/terms?conceptClass=Condition&conceptClass=Disorder&standardConcept=Standard&page=1&pageSize=15&query=Gastrointestinal+hemorrhage

The standard concept ID for "Gastrointestinal hemorrhage" is 192671.


8. Which ICD-10CM codes map to the standard concept for "Gastrointestinal hemorrhage"? Which ICD-9CM codes map to this Standard Concept?



```{r}
# uses this as a basis: https://github.com/OHDSI/OMOP-Queries/blob/master/md/General.md

DatabaseConnector::querySql(conn, "
  SELECT c2.vocabulary_id, c2.concept_code, c2.concept_name
  FROM main.concept_relationship cr
  JOIN main.concept c2 ON c2.concept_id = cr.concept_id_2
  WHERE cr.concept_id_1 = 192671
    AND cr.relationship_id = 'Mapped from'
    AND c2.vocabulary_id IN ('ICD10CM', 'ICD9CM')")

# Eunomia only has some of the concept_codes
```
Relevant Athena Search: https://athena.ohdsi.org/search-terms/terms?vocabulary=ICD10CM&vocabulary=ICD9CM&invalidReason=Valid&page=1&pageSize=15&query=%22Gastrointestinal+hemorrhage%22&boosts

The relevant ICD-10CM:
- K92.2 “Gastrointestinal hemorrhage, unspecified”

The relevant ICD-9CM:
- 578 “Gastrointestinal hemorrhage”
- relevant 'subsumed terms' like 578.9


## Advanced SQL

9. What is the minimum, maximum, and mean length (in days) of observation from the `synthetic` dataset? (Hint: you can use the `DATEDIFF` function to compute the time between two dates.)

Source: https://ohdsi.r-universe.dev/DatabaseConnector/doc/manual.html

```{r}
library(DatabaseConnector)

cd_synthetic <- createConnectionDetails(
  dbms   = "duckdb",
  server = "data/synthetic.duckdb"
)
conn_synthetic <- connect(cd_synthetic)
```
```{r}
# compute the length of each observation period (each row)
# DATEDIFF produces one number per row & 'day' argument is the units

sql <- "
  SELECT MIN(DATEDIFF(day, observation_period_start_date, observation_period_end_date)) AS min_days,
         MAX(DATEDIFF(day, observation_period_start_date, observation_period_end_date)) AS max_days,
         AVG(DATEDIFF(day, observation_period_start_date, observation_period_end_date)) AS mean_days
  FROM @cdm.observation_period;"

renderTranslateQuerySql(conn_synthetic, sql, cdm = "main")
```

```{r}
disconnect(conn_synthetic)
```

10. How many people have at least one prescription of celecoxib from the `Eunomia` dataset? (Note: there’s an easy way to do this, using `DRUG_ERA`, and a harder way using `DRUG_EXPOSURE` and `CONCEPT_ANCESTOR`. Can you do both?)

- DRUG_ERA, DRUG_EXPOSURE & CONCEPT_ANCESTOR are all tables under the main Schema
- DRUG_ERA can be directly filtered by the ingredient_ID level
- DRUG_EXPOSURE records specific products (e.g. Ibuprofen 200 MG Oral tablets)
- CONCEPT_ANCESTOR links the ingredient (ancestor) to products containing it

```{r}
# identify the celecoxib concept_id & identify its concept_class_id as ingredient

DatabaseConnector::querySql(conn, "
  SELECT concept_id, concept_name, concept_class_id
  FROM main.concept
  WHERE LOWER(concept_name) = 'celecoxib'
    AND vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'")
```
Relevant Athena Search: https://athena.ohdsi.org/search-terms/terms/1118084

```{r}
drugera_sql <- "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS n_people
        FROM @cdm.drug_era
        WHERE drug_concept_id = @ingredient_id;"

DatabaseConnector::renderTranslateQuerySql(conn, drugera_sql,
                                           cdm = "main",
                                           ingredient_id = 1118084)
```
```{r}
DE.CA_sql <- "
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS n_people
  FROM @cdm.drug_exposure de
  INNER JOIN @cdm.concept_ancestor ca
    ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = @ingredient_id;"

DatabaseConnector::renderTranslateQuerySql(conn, DE.CA_sql,
                                           cdm = "main",
                                           ingredient_id = 1118084)
```
Both methods arrive at 1844 people have at least one prescription of celecoxib from the `Eunomia` dataset.

```{r}
disconnect(conn)
```
